test_title: PYST 31: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Sanjay rolled the marble through a small plastic pipe.

options.text: A small plastic pipe was rolled through a marble by Sanjay.
The marble was rolled through a small plastic pipe by Sanjay.
The marble was rolled by Sanjay in a small plastic pipe.
The marble through a small plastic pipe was rolled by Sanjay.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The marble was rolled through a small plastic pipe by Sanjay.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **Active Voice**, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In **Passive Voice**, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence. T
 
• The given sentence is in the **active voice** and it is in **the past simple tense**.
 
• When we convert this sentence into a **passive voice**, the **subject ''Sanjay'' **of the active voice **becomes the object**, the **object ''** **the marble****'' **becomes the **subject.**
 
• The active format **"V2 (rolled)" **should be converted into the passive format **"was + V2 (rolled)"**.
 
• This is the **active and passive voice rule for the past simple tense.**
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 2'**.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *The marble was rolled through a small plastic pipe by Sanjay.*
